_note: push/561, HIDDEN: The Driftline, Skyglass for levels 30 to 80 (dauntless's go 2026-11-09, 'Build it'). Three AI copies of the live Faded Wayfinder, Core Horror and Captain (kit, rules and sprite copied whole from push/560's capture; -50% damage given; Core Horror pools 6 -> 3, Captain 4 -> 2, stun immunity kept). Two untradeable chart items (Chart of the Split Hold, Chart of the Broken Stern; placeholder icons). Five quests: Into the Driftline (one-time), Beachcombing (daily), The Split Hold, The Broken Stern (chart runs), The Salvager's Tally. Wins pay Wreck Salvage (Beachcombing 1, the Split Hold and the Broken Stern 2). Every fight scaled to the player with a full refill (givePools 100); a lost fight ends the run. Nothing visible to players. Into, Beachcombing and the Tally are mastery so they can be playtested hidden; the go-live batch makes them overworld at the salvager's NPC (Into after Wreck Sighted), adds the Faded Wreck drop rows and unhides. Generated by push/driftline.gen.py; do not hand-edit.

data.name: Chart of the Split Hold
data.description:
A rough sketch of the hold where the Wreck broke apart in the shallows, drawn on a plank that washed up with the tide. The hull splits two ways at the bottom.

The Split Hold · Battle Arena · The Driftline
Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up.
Difficulty: ★★☆☆☆
At the split: go port or starboard for the last fight.
Chance drops: Chart of the Broken Stern 20% · Sealed Treasury 3%
Choose one: Medicine Inro · Elemental Tool Pouch · Galley Stores ×2 · Chart of the Buried Cache · Tide Chart ×2 · Watch Roster ×2
Spent when the run starts. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first. Can't be traded.

data.name: Chart of the Broken Stern
data.description:
The stern's own deck plan, salt-stiff and torn along the keel. Someone aboard marked the helm in red and wrote one word under it: still.

The Broken Stern · Battle Arena · The Driftline
Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up.
Difficulty: ★★★☆☆
Chance drops: Chart of the Captain's Watch 5% · Sealed Treasury 4%
Choose one: Skyglass Coffer · Skyglass Token · Galley Stores ×3 · Chart of the Split Hold ×2
Spent when the run starts. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first. Can't be traded.

data.name: Into the Driftline
data.description:
The salvager has found something on the beach below the Wreck: pieces of her, broken off and drifted ashore, with Faded crew still standing their posts. She wants you to see.

Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first.
data.successDescription: The salvager showed you the Driftline. Come back to her fire each day to walk the tideline, and carry its charts to the Battle Arena.

objectives.description: The salvager is up to her knees in the surf, hauling a broken rib of the Wreck onto the sand. "You again. Good. Look at this." The whole tideline is littered with planks and glass. "She sheds when the tide pulls at her. Whole decks break off and drift in, and the crew come with them."

"Faded ones. They don't know the ship left them behind. They keep their posts on whatever piece of her they washed in on." She points down the beach, where two figures stand watch on a split hatch. "The deep decks are for Jonin. The shallows are yours. Clear those two and I'll show you where the rest of her drifted."
A Deck Warden and his Seal Charge stand their post on a hatch half sunk in sand.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The two fade into the spray. Under the hatch you find a plank with a hold sketched on it, and the salvager whistles. "That's the Split Hold. It came in whole. Go and see what's still in it." From now on she keeps the Driftline's runs for you in the Battle Arena.
The tide knocks you flat, and the watch goes on without you. The salvager will wait.

data.name: Beachcombing
data.description:
Every tide leaves more of the Wreck on the sand, and more of her crew walking it. Once a day, walk the tideline and take what they guard.

Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first.
data.successDescription: You walked the tideline and came back with the tide's leavings.

objectives.description: Low tide. The beach below the Wreck is a field of wreckage, and the Faded crew walk it as if it were still a deck. A Deck Warden and a Seal Charge are working their way along the tideline toward you.
The Deck Warden calls the watch, and the Seal Charge comes in low.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The tideline is quiet until the next tide. You pick through what they were guarding.
The watch drives you off the sand. The tide will turn again tomorrow.

data.name: The Split Hold
data.description:
A whole hold broke off the Wreck and drifted into the shallows. Three fights, and at the bottom the hull splits: port or starboard.

Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first.
data.successDescription: You came up out of the Split Hold with what the sea had left.

objectives.description: The Split Hold lies on its side in the shallows, the sea running in and out of it. A Faded Deck Warden keeps the hatch with a Seal Charge, both still dripping.
The Deck Warden plants himself in the hatch.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Below, the stores are knee-deep in seawater. An Arsenal Keeper counts the crates that are left, and he does not like your face.
The Arsenal Keeper reaches for his charges.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: At the bottom the hull has cracked clean in two. To port, a Skyglass Sentinel and the First Blade hold the armory. To starboard, a Wayfinder bends over a soaked chart while an Oathkeeper stands over him.
The Sentinel's glass flares, and the First Blade steps in behind it.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Wayfinder marks you on his chart, and the Oathkeeper raises his blade.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The armory is yours, what the sea left of it.
The Wayfinder's chart is ruined, but the stores behind him are not.
The sea pours into the hold behind you, and the run is over.

data.name: The Broken Stern
data.description:
The Wreck's stern ran aground on the bar, upright and crewed, with its Captain still at the helm. Four fights: the gangway, the chart room, the hold and the helm.

Levels 30 to 80. Enemies match your level. Opens to Genin and up. You start every fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose a fight and the run ends. Claim any waiting reward first.
data.successDescription: The Broken Stern is quiet, and its Captain has let go of the wheel.

objectives.description: The Broken Stern has run aground on the bar, upright, as if she were still under way. Two Faded Deck Wardens and a Seal Charge hold the gangway.
The Deck Wardens close ranks on the gangway.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: In the chart room a Faded Oathkeeper guards the Wayfinder, who is still plotting a course for a ship that is not moving.
The Oathkeeper steps between you and the Wayfinder.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Below, something heavy moves in the flooded hold. The Core Horror has come in with this piece of her, smaller than the one in the deep, and just as hungry. Watch the floor: red means move.
The Driftline Core Horror rises out of the bilge.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: At the helm the Captain stands with both hands on the wheel, steering a stern that has no ship in front of it. He turns his head. "You're not on my roster."
The Driftline Captain lets go of the wheel.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: The Captain fades with his hands back on the wheel. The stern is quiet, and the tide lifts her a little, as if she were finally free to go.
The stern keeps her crew, and you wash back up on the sand.

data.name: The Salvager's Tally
data.description:
The salvager keeps a tally of who brings what up from the shallows. Four orders, each with a reward to claim, and a last reward for all four: one Shard of the Keel and a Skyglass Token.

Orders, in any order:
1. Win Beachcombing, the Low Tide Run, the Night Watch or the Rotted Galley, 3 times in total.
2. Win the Split Hold or the Buried Cache once.
3. Win the Split Hold or the Drowned Foundry, 2 times in total.
4. Win the Broken Stern or the Captain's Watch once.

Every order has a level-80 run beside it, so the tally still counts after you pass 80. Orders count only once you've taken the tally.
data.successDescription: Tally complete. The salvager presses a shard of the keel into your hand. "You've earned the deep. Don't drown in it."

objectives.description:
Bring something up from the tideline.

Win Beachcombing, the Low Tide Run, the Night Watch or the Rotted Galley, 3 times in total. Reward when you claim it: Galley Stores ×2.
objectives.successDescription: Three hauls off the sand. She chalks them on the hull.

objectives.description:
Go into a broken hold.

Win the Split Hold or the Buried Cache once. Reward when you claim it: an Elemental Tool Pouch.
objectives.successDescription: You came back out of the hold, which is more than most do.

objectives.description:
Learn the ship's lower decks.

Win the Split Hold or the Drowned Foundry, 2 times in total. Reward when you claim it: a Skyglass Coffer.

Stand at a helm.

Win the Broken Stern or the Captain's Watch once. Reward when you claim it: a Sealed Treasury.
objectives.successDescription: A Captain fell to you. The deep decks will hear of it.
